Helping Your Boyfriend

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Android

Download NowName your own price
If you had a hot, smart, rich, and sweet doctor boyfriend, but you couldn't walk, would you feel lucky?

♡ A cute-turned-creepy horror visual novel

♡ Customize your name, pronouns & body type

♡ 4 endings

♡ 5 minigames

✦ 115 CGs & character sprites · 30 backgrounds

✦ 8,000+ words (English) · Also playable in Thai


You play as the lover of Adrian, a sweet and caring doctor. Since a leg illness left you unable to walk, you moved in with him. Because of your condition, you only wake up late at night, right when Adrian gets home from work. To keep you busy, he brings you a weird job. He asks you to help take apart old dolls. This becomes your everyday routine.

But one night, while you're fast asleep, you feel a heavy weight on top of you. You open your eyes and see a strange man's shadow. Panic sets in. You try to scream for help, but the man pins you down and tightly covers your mouth.

He holds a pill in front of your face.

"Take this, or you die." 

You can't walk. You can't run. Will you take the pill?


⚠ Helping Your Boyfriend is not for players who are easily disturbed.

Jumpscares · Loud noises · Flashing & disturbing images · Blood & cartoon gore · Violence · Drug use · Unhealthy, obsessive behavior · Toxic relationships · Crude Language

All characters and events are fictional. We don't condone anything in the game. If it gets too much, please stop and take care of yourself first ♡


Left Click / Enter: advance text & choose

Mouse: point-and-click, drag in minigames

Space: hide/show the dialogue box

L: history log

A: auto-play

Ctrl (hold) / Tab: skip text

Arrow keys + Spacebar: quick-time events (QTE)

Click the bell at the top for the in-game menu (Save / Load / Settings…)

Keep going against Adrian for the whole game, though. You don't gain anything from his approval.
